title: Native API v2 pre-lock breaking-change approvals
description: One entry per approved breaking change against the merge base, keyed by the exact operation and the change fingerprint the semantic diff prints. No entry may be a pattern; prose alone approves nothing. Ignored entirely once contracts/api/v2/LOCKED exists.

operation_id.description: The one operationId the change is on; a component change is approved under the operation that exposes it.

change_id.description: The oasdiff rule id the diff reported.

fingerprint.description: The 64-hex SHA-256 the diff prints for this exact change.

reason.description: Why the break is accepted pre-lock and how clients were coordinated.

approved_in.description: The pull request or issue that ratified it, as #NNN.
